purpose: Promote already-current shared procedures from the reviewed Rulebook into game-data/current-game.json so the Comprehensive Rules can remain a complete direct authority projection.

deck_construction: three different Territories and one-Arena maximum
actions_and_assets: Action-card play procedure and default destination
Asset as the only banked-card effect heading
movement_and_battle: Advance, Hold, and Fall Back definitions
withdrawal positional branches and Onset/post-Onset behavior
effect_and_timing: optional extra Gambits/Tactics and simultaneous multi-Tactic choice
cards_becoming_territories: Manifest Destiny becomes a normal Territory with a normal Deed and uses existing Deed rules

source_status: These procedures already exist in the current reviewed player-facing Rulebook and/or partial current structured authority. This normalization makes them explicit in the sole canonical gameplay authority; it does not intentionally alter gameplay.

authority_layout.principle: Rules are stored in their natural existing gameplay domains rather than in a parallel shared-rules corpus.
authority_layout.new_domain: gameplay.card_zones is added because shared zone definitions previously had no canonical structured home. It owns zone identity and information state; turn/battle domains remain the sole authority for procedural values such as Hand limit, Reserve size, sources, destinations, and recycling.
authority_layout.assets: gameplay.card_rules.assets owns the previously missing Asset-limit, replacement, and Action-default rules; gameplay.card_rules.inherent_bank_action remains the sole Bank procedure and gameplay.card_rules.asset_removal remains the sole Removal classification.
authority_layout.shorthand: Reserve/Tactic modifier stacking is owned by gameplay.card_rules.compact_shorthand rather than duplicated in multiple-card permission rules.
authority_layout.registry: New granular registry entries fingerprint card zones and the shared card/battle subdomains needed by direct publication; existing broad core dependencies remain valid.

migration: One-time branch materialization and finalization scripts/workflows were used to write and deduplicate the normalized authority and registry. They were removed before merge; the materialized current-game and contract data are the durable result.
validation: scripts/validate-shared-rules-authority.mjs asserts completeness, single-source ownership, registry dependencies, and key invariants for the normalized shared domains.
Rules publication authority CI runs the permanent shared-rules validator.
No one-time migration, finalization script, or write workflow is required after merge.
